changes.title: Legend sites
items: A legend's circle is always in its own legend area: two legend areas no longer share one area, so a circle no longer turns up in the wrong one.
Stumps, legend circles, the challenge circle and home now keep at least 50 m apart, and 10 m from any lake: stumps no longer crowd each other or stand in the water.
Areas are bigger (about 196 m across, not 168) to make room, so islands are about a sixth larger and the sea chart with them.
Creatures and legends heading across a lake no longer get stuck turning back and forth at its shore, and the beach witches always sit on sand with room for their campfire.

changes.title: Guard chain
items: A creature parked at a sigil outside home now guards as far as its chain reaches (80 m), not 40 m.
A creature parked in the home area, or waiting there while you're in the treehouse, now roams the whole home area instead of standing by its sigil, and still defends it.

changes.title: Treehouse one room
items: The treehouse is one open home: Bedrooms 2 and 3 are open to walk into (their furniture still under dust sheets), and the canopy indoors opens in a circle round you.
The cauldron's smoke now spreads 10 m round the pot for about ten seconds, and anyone who walks into it takes the potion.

changes.title: Guest beach cache
items: Visiting a friend's island no longer rebuilds its beach for every game and music update.
